title:
Comment of bradley allen pierson in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 10/12/2026

documents.name: 151545.txt
documents.text:
bradley allen pierson, Anchor Point, AK.
The short sighted nature of this data center proposal is concerning. Any proposed data center must be above ground and have the following characteristics:
Fully independent power source
Independent water source
Green belt around the facility to reduce light & sound pollution
Reverse osmosis (or similar) water filtration prior to releasing water from containment into the environment
All potential environmental clean up expenses must be fully funded & in a 3rd party, interest accruing account
Zero tax dollars used in development
Zero tax exemptions going forward

I am not inherently opposed to data centers, but the small short term gain the community might receive should not over shadow the ongoing hazards presented. Proper mitigation of the hazards is the only way forward.
